name: JANUS SIT0 — Hawking Dedication: Source-Invariant Trace & Observational Replay

dedication.note_ru: Исследовательское посвящение Стивену Хокингу за исследования стрелы времени, физических следов и причинности; не является утверждением о его участии или одобрении.
dedication.physics_scope: Physical observed past stays unchanged; only post-hoc computational evidence tracing goes C→B→A, then forwards A→B→C.

purpose: First real-observation-derived test of Janus Cosmos R37F3A native natural-line preservation processing combined with pinned TACHYON R5F stock-mirror provenance graph and forward replay. Research-only read-only sidecar.

source.original_observations: Two Breakthrough Listen observed 6.6685192 GHz methanol-maser lines with native 2.7939677 Hz filterbank source and 715.2557 Hz averaged real derived profiles.
source.physical_source_lineage: R37F2D3 published-MD5-pinned raw filterbank download → archived real derived NPZ normalized profile → R37F3A previous source checksum and science checks. SIT0 does not redownload raw original .fil.
source.model_source: R37A deterministic area-overlap rebin functions; NO R42A8A frozen shadow scorer, because 1D real native profile is not the validated input schema of the frozen 16×128 synthetic R42A8A learner

observational_sample.transform_settings: Exactly the eight predetermined R37F3A factors/phases; no calibration parameter retuning.

adversarial.label_leakage_rule: Mutation type never given to inference functions or used by witness validation; only scorer uses overlay category after predictions.
adversarial.guard: Corruptions do not alter original archived spectrum, measured line, native rebin output, or any detection/observational source.

computational_lineage.A: Authenticated real-derived spectral profile (SHA256 and original source/MJD)
computational_lineage.B: Native COSMOS R37A area-conserving rebin spectrum (SHA256, width factor/phase)
computational_lineage.C: COSMOS R37F3A measured feature profile and preservation/review verdict (SHA256)
computational_lineage.forward: Recompute original untouched COSMOS rebin and feature verdict and verify every SHA/provenance assertion
computational_lineage.metric_note: Even a native REVIEW verdict may have intact provenance; SIT0 must not silently filter its observations.

arms.COSMOS_NATIVE_WITHOUT_OVERLAY_AUDIT: Native real-derived 16 real reductions are computed and unchanged; deliberately no checking of newly injected metadata.
arms.TACHYON_MIRROR_GRAPH_ONLY: Actual pinned DemiHead transposed DAG path check, no data/hash verification.
arms.TACHYON_MIRROR_PLUS_FORWARD_REPLAY: Pinned mirror DAG path + full source/artifact/digest verification and actual area-rebin + feature verdict recomputation.
arms.STRONG_DIRECT_PROVENANCE_REPLAY: Strong standalone exact provenance and native rebin/feature checks on exactly same evidence.

gates.acceptance: 16 authentic real-derived profile/transform chains loaded and hash/shape/finite verified, each source separate; all 128 metadata-overlay trials completed; for TACHYON forward replay and strong direct require 16 intact accepted and 112 flawed metadata rejected; no original spectral/detection changes.
gates.no_scientific_sensitivity_claim: Do NOT score astronomical false positives, localization, drift sensitivity, weak transmitter recovery or physical ON/OFF from 1D natural methanol profile.
gates.required_gold_scope: Gold means manifest integrity after controlled overlays, NOT whether source physically emitted signal or whether detector is correct.
gates.strong_baseline: Do not claim win over exact direct provenance unless real paired metric shows it; research preview expects equality.
